sources.claim: Mainnet4663/testnet46630; archive endpoints recommended for historical reads. Public endpoints explicitly rate-limited and not recommended for production. Provider credentials and plan remain to be selected.
Official documentation describes AggregatorV3 crypto feeds and refers users to Chainlink directory; no selected two-source PoPL pairing is established by this page.
No Robinhood entry found on the current supported-networks page. This does not prove every independent randomness service is absent.
Current address list omits Robinhood and explicitly states no expansion to new networks. A genuine source or independently reviewed no-feed policy remains unresolved.

A self-managed feed exposes familiar interfaces but its publication/monitoring/service levels belong to the external operator. Interface/runtime similarity does not prove independent reporting or Chainlink-managed operation.
Documents a Data Streams verifier on4663. A pull verifier is not a drop-in independently updated AggregatorV3 source; no ZZZ stream or qualified adapter was selected.
Robinhood Chain appears in the official supported-chain list. This is marketplace network support, not acceptance of this custom primary mint.
Primary drops use SeaDrop-compatible integration. Current PoPL source lacks mintSeaDrop integration and needs product/contract approval; no adapter or fee/recipient policy is assumed.
Official mint transaction API supports ERC721 SeaDropV1 drops, separately requiring actual drop eligibility/configuration; no custom PoPL drop is deployed or approved.
Provider publishes Robinhood deployments, but its distinct SDK/request/proof/admin/recovery semantics remain unapproved. No new runtime observation or audit was performed.

Provider documents thresholdBLS native-only request service and zero-keyHash/group-current semantics; current PoPL requires nonzero lane and original-provider immutable configuration. Claims require independent proof/admin/recovery review, not guard removal.
Unknown blockHash must fail rather than silently resolve latest. A transport timeout alone is not evidence of standards-compliant rejection.
callTracer withLog is an explicit option collecting emitted logs. Merely accepting the option on a no-log read does not prove usable event witnesses.
